$comment: Windy Admin ops surface — Class C, the LAST procession platform. admin.windyword.ai is the ecosystem's super-admin dashboard + telemetry ingest. Notable connection: admin ALREADY exposes GET /dashboard/fleet — a live '/version fan-out' across the whole fleet — which is the natural home for the Steamroller's fleet-version PUBLISHER (L2 deferred item). The dashboards + ingest + member/cost/audit surfaces are admin's PRODUCT and stay out per §2; this contract is admin's own health + the fleet read. get_capabilities → /dashboard/fleet is admin-gated → band_floor TRUSTED.

get_capabilities.note: admin's signature read: a live /version fan-out across every platform — which services are up and on what build. Admin-gated (TRUSTED). This is where the Steamroller fleet-version publisher should live (L2).

get_logs.note: content-free; the /events surfaces are telemetry, not logs.

restart_app.note: out-of-band; ops plane outside the patient.

set_setting.note: alert thresholds/flags are mutable via product routes — expose via ops later if useful.

reset_to_defaults.note: holds the ecosystem's telemetry + audit history.

tools.name: get_health
tools.description: The FIRST call when the admin dashboard or telemetry ingest seems down. Liveness of Windy Admin, including a real check that its database is reachable.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Read Windy Admin's deployment identity — which build of the admin panel is serving right now. Use this to confirm a fix actually deployed.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Get the whole ecosystem's fleet status in one call — a live fan-out that asks every Windy platform which build it is running and whether it is up. The single best 'is the whole fleet healthy' view. Admin-only.
